channel: allcoredevs/_threads/Following up on today's decision to [SFI
searchText: I thought we were agreeing to Frames as headliner tbh; that's why SFI ahead of the decision around other EIPs It was denied for headliner so only CFI; with condition that that decision could be revisited later. We revisited it and SFI'd it, so headliner? (More general AA as headliner was the stop gap until we decided what the SFI for it was) Funfact, Meta EIPs don't currently record headliners. Created PRs to change this. Add headliners to Glamsterdam https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12254 Add headliner to Hegotá https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12255 Frames can be then added as a headliner if decided at ACDE. Added my take in comment section. My preference is to continue present style of documentation. But, open for changes with proper documentation. https://x.com/ben_a_adams/status/2093340730068496430

Created PRs to change this.

Add headliners to Glamsterdam
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12254

Add headliner to Hegotá
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12255

Frames can be then added as a headliner if decided at ACDE.
